function: no_learning: resources solved by alternating optimization (SDR, CVaR, closed-form power rule, Hungarian); the 'self-learning' is only a sample-quantile estimate of an affine uncertainty set (p. 7).
notes: Reason no_learning. Abstract (p. 1) mentions 'self-learning based power allocation', but p. 7 (Eqs. 28-30) only sorts S=5000 samples and takes the (1-delta)-quantile as the size of an affine uncertainty set; no model is trained. The power rule is closed-form (p. 8, Eq. 38, O(1)); the MUD matrix and IRS phase shifts come from SDR/CVaR convex programs solved with CVX (p. 5-7); all benchmarks are non-learned (p. 10). Not graded. PDF is the arXiv v1 preprint (arXiv:2504.11871v1), title 'Channel-Adaptive Robust Resource Allocation for Highly Reliable IRS-Assisted V2X Communications', not verified against the DOI.
